title: Te Oati a te Mea Kāore anō kia Whānau
intro: I mua i te taenga mai o tētahi tamaiti, i oati te wairua pono i tētahi kupu tapu. Kei roto i ngā pakitara o tētahi wāhi tapu te kōrero mō tēnei tangata, te wāhi e tūtaki ai te aroha ki te manako o te Atua. Ko wai tēnei pononga a Allah?
clues: Nō tētahi whānau ahau i whakanuia i roto i te Quran.
I oati ahau ki te whakatapua i taku tamaiti kāore anō kia whānau ki te mahi ki a Allah.
I taku whānautanga, i miharo ahau i te kitenga he tamāhine, ahakoa i tumanako ahau he tama.
I tapaina e au tāku tamaiti ko Meriama, he ingoa e whakaatu ana i te aroha me te mahi.
I rapu ahau i te tiaki a Allah mō taku tamaiti me āna uri i te rewera kua kanga.
I manakohia taku tamaiti e te Ariki, ā, i tukuna ki raro i te tiaki a te Poropiti, a Hakaraia, i roto i te whare tapu.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te wahine a Imran (Whaea o Meriama)
Asiya, te wahine a Parao
Ko Meriama, te whaea o Īha
Te whaea o te Poropiti a Mohi
Te Kuīni o Sheba
identity.answer: Te wahine a Imran (Whaea o Meriama)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te oati ki te whakatapua i tana tamaiti ki te temepara
Te maka ki roto i te ahi
Te whiti i te moana i runga i te whenua maroke
Te hanga i tētahi āka nui
Te horomia e te ika nui
trial.answer: Te oati ki te whakatapua i tana tamaiti ki te temepara

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Te wāhi tapu (mihrab) i whakatakotoria ai tana tamaiti
Te aaka o te kawenata
Te kuao kau koura
Te tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
Te nikau tāte i okioki ai ia
location.answer: Te wāhi tapu (mihrab) i whakatakotoria ai tana tamaiti

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakaaetia tana tamaiti, ā, i tukuna ki raro i te tiaki a te Poropiti, a Hakaraia.
I whakaorangia ia i te whiu a te kaitukino
I whānau mai he tama ki a ia, ko Yahya tōna ingoa
I whakangaromia tōna iwi e te tupuhi
I noho ia hei kuini mō tētahi rangatiratanga nui
outcome.answer: I whakaaetia tana tamaiti, ā, i tukuna ki raro i te tiaki a te Poropiti, a Hakaraia.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
